scamshield.ui.title: Scam Shield
scamshield.flag.reward: Too good to be true reward
scamshield.flag.small_trust_payment: Small payment to unlock big money
scamshield.scenario.upiRefund.message: Your UPI payment of ₹2,000 failed. Please accept this Collect Request to get your refund immediately.
scamshield.scenario.upiRefund.tell: Refunds never require you to enter your UPI PIN. A collect request means money is going OUT of your account.
scamshield.scenario.qrScanReceive.messag: Congratulations! You won ₹5,000. Scan this QR code and enter your PIN to receive the prize money in your account.
scamshield.scenario.qrScanReceive.tell: Scanning a QR code and entering a PIN is ONLY for sending money, never for receiving.
scamshield.scenario.fakeTask.message: Earn ₹2,000 daily by liking YouTube videos. Deposit a ₹500 registration fee to unlock your first task.
scamshield.scenario.fakeTask.tell: Real jobs pay you, they don't ask you to pay them first. This is a classic task scam.
scamshield.scenario.instantLoan.message: Pre-approved loan of ₹50,000! Download this app now. We do not check CIBIL score. Offer expires in 10 mins.
scamshield.scenario.instantLoan.tell: Fake loan apps steal your contacts and photos to blackmail you later.
scamshield.scenario.kycExpires.message: Dear customer, your bank account will be blocked today due to pending KYC. Click here to update: http://bit.ly/bank-kyc-update
scamshield.scenario.kycExpires.tell: Banks never send suspension threats with unverified links. The link goes to a fake login page.
scamshield.scenario.digitalArrest.messag: (Call from 'Customs Officer') Your parcel contains illegal items. You are under digital arrest. Pay ₹50,000 security deposit to clear your name.
scamshield.scenario.digitalArrest.tell: There is no such thing as a 'digital arrest' in Indian law. Police will never ask for a security deposit to clear you.
scamshield.scenario.doubleMoney.message: Double your money in 25 days! Guaranteed returns by expert crypto traders. DM to join VIP group.
scamshield.scenario.doubleMoney.tell: If they could double their own money, they wouldn't need yours. 'Guaranteed returns' on crypto is a huge red flag.
scamshield.scenario.telegramTips.message: Join my VIP Telegram channel. Pay ₹2,000 for 100% accurate stock market tips. Don't miss the multibagger tomorrow!
scamshield.scenario.telegramTips.tell: Unregistered tipsters are illegal. They use you to artificially pump up a stock they already bought.
scamshield.scenario.scholarshipFee.messa: You are selected for the National Merit Scholarship of ₹50,000. Pay ₹250 processing fee to our bank account to release funds.
scamshield.scenario.scholarshipFee.tell: Government scholarships do not ask for an upfront processing fee to a personal bank account.
scamshield.scenario.genuineBank.message: A/c *1234 debited by INR 500.00 on 10-Oct. Available Bal: INR 12,500.00. Call 1800-XXX-XXXX if not done by you.
scamshield.scenario.genuineBank.tell: This is a genuine bank alert. It doesn't ask you to click a link or pay anything.
scamshield.scenario.genuineUpi.message: Paid ₹150 to 'Raju Store' via UPI. UPI Ref: 123456789.
scamshield.scenario.genuineUpi.tell: Standard confirmation of a payment you just made at a shop. Perfectly safe.
scamshield.scenario.genuineScholarship.m: Application received. Please check the status of your scholarship on the official portal: scholarships.gov.in.
scamshield.scenario.genuineScholarship.t: Directs you to a verifiable government portal (.gov.in) and doesn't ask for money or passwords.
scamshield.scenario.genuineTax.message: Your Income Tax Return for AY 25-26 has been processed. Check your status at incometax.gov.in.
scamshield.scenario.genuineTax.tell: Standard government notice. Tells you to visit the official site yourself, rather than clicking a sketchy link.
scamshield.checkIt.title: Check-It Tool
scamshield.checkIt.q3: Money goes to a company account, not a personal UPI?
scamshield.checkIt.q4: Easy and clear way to withdraw money?
scamshield.checkIt.q5: Can you easily explain how it works to a friend?
scamshield.checkIt.verdictSafe: Looks promising. Verify on official sites before paying.
scamshield.checkIt.verdictStop: More than one 'No' → Stop! Ask a trusted adult.
scamshield.nowWhat.title: I've been scammed. Now what?
scamshield.nowWhat.step1_desc: Do not pay any more money. Block the scammer immediately.
scamshield.nowWhat.step2_desc: Call your bank's official number to freeze your account/cards.
scamshield.nowWhat.step3_desc: Dial the national cybercrime helpline. Fast action can freeze the stolen money.
scamshield.nowWhat.step4_desc: Take screenshots of chats, payment receipts, and links.
scamshield.nowWhat.step6_desc: Don't let shame keep you silent. Tell a trusted adult to get support.
